'''Misha Vekkian''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. After the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], she was turned to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] by the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]], a group of [[Dark side adept/Legends|Dark Side Adepts]] who served as the Empire's [[Jedi hunter/Legends|Jedi hunters]]. After undergoing military training, Vekkian joined the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] and attained the rank of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]].

When the [[Alderaanian Resistance]], an anti-Imperial group based on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], sent a task force to wait near [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to rendezvous with agents returning from a [[Mission to Coruscant (Imperial era)|mission]] there, Vekkian was among the Imperial forces sent to [[Battle of the Resurgence|destroy]] the group. She was part of a boarding party that landed on the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]], the [[Resurgence (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Resurgence'']], and took up a position in the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Hangar/Legends|landing bay]] along with a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Imperial Navy Trooper/Legends|Imperial Navy troopers]] under her command. After witnessing Inquisitor [[Valin Draco]] leave the ship with the captured [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Denia]], Vekkian and her squad attacked a group of Alderaanian Resistance fighters.

==Biography==
Vekkian was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was raised by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] with no knowledge of her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] or her family, and by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], she had become a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]. However, after the end of the conflict, she was discovered by the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]],<ref name="AROW" /> an order of [[Dark side adept/Legends|Dark Side Adepts]] who served the newly-formed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], which was tasked with [[Jedi hunter/Legends|hunting down]] the surviving Jedi.<ref name="TDSS">''[[The Dark Side Sourcebook]]''</ref> The Inquisitorius turned her to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] and she agreed to serve the Empire. After undergoing military training, she was commissioned as an [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. Vekkian attained the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] and commanded a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Imperial Navy Trooper/Legends|Imperial Navy troopers]] who, due to her harsh style, became some of the toughest and skilled men in the Imperial Navy.<ref name="AROW" />

Around [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The ''Dawn of Defiance'' module ''[[Echoes of the Jedi]]'' states that the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vhiin Thorla]] traveled to the [[Almas Academy]] two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the declaration of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], which is dated to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. This thus indicates that ''Dawn of Defiance'' is set in around [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]].</ref> Imperial [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilder Varth]] infiltrated the [[Alderaanian Resistance]], an anti-Imperial resistance group based on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. When a team of Resistance agents completed a [[Mission to Coruscant (Imperial era)|mission]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], a Resistance task force was sent to wait for them at a rendezvous point near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Varth betrayed the Resistance task force's location to the Empire and an Imperial task force under the command of Inquisitor [[Valin Draco]] was sent to [[Battle of the Resurgence|eliminate]] the group. Vekkian and her squad accompanied him and they were part of a boarding party that landed aboard the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Command ship/Legends|command]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] [[Resurgence (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Resurgence'']].<ref name="AROW" />

Draco captured [[Denia]], a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who had allied herself with the Resistance, and took her to the ''Resurgence''{{'s}} [[Hangar/Legends|landing bay]]. Vekkian and her squad were present there while he and his [[Prison/Legends|prisoner]] left the ship in his [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], and afterward, they took up positions near the last Imperial shuttle left on the ship. Soon, a group of Alderaanian Resistance fighters, who had been carrying out assignments for Denia, arrived at the hangar, though too late to rescue her. Vekkian noticed their presence and ordered her squad to open fire on them. She then ignited her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and used [[Battle meditation/Legends|battle meditation]] to prepare herself for combat. The naval [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] gave her covering fire, while she tried to attack the Resistance fighters. The battle was a victory for the Empire and the ''Resurgence'' was destroyed shortly afterward, while the surviving Alderaanian ships were forced to flee.<ref name="AROW" />

==Personality and traits==
Misha Vekkian was a tall woman, with an athletic build; [[Color/Legends|blonde]], close-cropped [[Hair/Legends|hair]]; and blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. Vekkian blamed the Jedi for her fall to the dark side, as she believed that if she had been left with her parents, then her [[The Force/Legends|Force]] sensitivity might never have been discovered. She was very cruel to the troops who served under her and she would [[Death/Legends|kill]] any of them who did not succeed in their goals, which caused them to both fear and respect her. Her squad was apprehensive of her and this made them completely loyal; they believed that if they even considered taking her down, she would be able to read their minds and stop them. She was spiteful and never forgot any sleight that she perceived to be against her. She was also vindictive and knew no mercy.<ref name="AROW" />

==Powers and abilities==
Vekkian had learned how to use the ancient [[Force power/Legends|technique]] of battle meditation, preferring to employ it before entering combat. When in combat, her favored tactic was to deflect the [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolts fired at her by an enemy, while she got close enough to them to engage them in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat with her lightsaber]]. She also employed [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]] to move and grip objects, in addition to [[Force Enrage|channeling her rage]], which she could use to augment her fighting skills.<ref name="AROW" />

==Equipment==
Though she carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], Vekkian preferred to fight with her lightsaber instead.<ref name="AROW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Misha Vekkian made her first and only appearance in ''[[A Reckoning of Wraiths]]'', the seventh scenario in the ''[[Dawn of Defiance]]'' campaign, written by [[Gary Astleford]]&mdash;a [[Wizards of the Coast]] online supplement to the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''. In the supplement, the player characters fight Vekkian and her squad, so her ultimate fate depends upon their actions and it is possible for them to kill her. If they do so, then her squad retreats back to the remaining Imperial shuttle and leaves the ''Resurgence''.<ref name="AROW" />
